description: Change the cook's saved Befana preferences. When the cook asks in their own words for a specific change to units, household size (servings), weeknight time, skill, equipment, cuisines, pantry, store or how you work with them (workflow: "switch me to metric", "set us to 4 people", "stop offering shopping lists", "always make the list"), that request is their yes: save it with cook_confirmed and tell them what changed (and that they can change it in Settings). For allergies, diets, the avoid list and privacy settings, and for any change you are proposing or the cook only mentioned in passing ("we're usually 4"), first tell the cook exactly what you will change and get a clear yes; set cook_confirmed only then. Never infer allergies or diets from conversation ("I'm making a cheese-free dinner" is not a milk allergy): only add them when the cook states them and confirms they should be saved. Pass only the fields to change. Lists replace the saved list, so read get_preferences first and send the full new list.

allergies.description: Major allergens: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree_nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame

avoid_mode.description: exclude hides those recipes; rank_lower shows them lower

cook_confirmed.description: True only when the cook asked for this exact change in their own words (units, household size and the other non-health settings) or said yes to it after you showed it (always for allergies, diets, avoid list, privacy)

do_not_sell.description: True keeps the cook out of every aggregated data product Befana sells or licenses

servings.description: Household size; null to use each recipe's own

servings_mode.description: offer (default): recipes open at their own servings and the household size is offered; always: recipes open scaled to it. Lists and meal plans use the household size either way

share_region.description: False stops usage counts from recording the cook's state or country

workflow.description: How the cook wants you to work with them. Pass only the keys that change

offer_fork_on_substitution.description: Saving the cook's own version after a swap. always still shows the changes and needs their yes; it only skips asking to save

offer_pantry_update.description: Adding an order to the pantry and taking a cooked recipe's ingredients off it

offer_shopping_list.description: Shopping list after a recipe or plan: always (make it without asking), ask, never (stop offering)

plan_meals.description: The cook's usual number of meals for plan_meals

setup_questions.description: never stops questions like household size

whats_new.description: off stops mentions of new Befana features

name: update_preferences
title: Change the cook's preferences
